text:
naomi: quick sync — a couple of enterprise customers asked for a single machine-readable endpoint that tells them what a runtime supports (tools, streaming, structured output, token limits). proposal: /v1/models/{id}/manifest. want to align on fields + launch checklist before i slot into roadmap.

huan: +1. minimal shape I'd expect: streaming (bool), tools: [names+versions], max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, supported_formats (json|text), stability_score (optional). sample:```{
  \"streaming\": true,
  \"tools\": [{\"name\": \"web_search\", \"version\": \"1.2\"}],
  \"max_input_tokens\": 8192,
  \"max_output_tokens\": 4096,
  \"supported_formats\": [\"json\", \"text\"]
}```

kevin: runtime note: quantized variants may not do streaming or certain tool integrations (gptq kernels + KV caching caveats). we need a \"compatibility_matrix\" hint or fallback mapping to recommend compatible variants. otherwise customers will expect impossible combos.

sara: can we add a small policy block: rate_limit_recommendation and cacheable_prefix boolean? ops needs guidance for client's client-side sharding and batching. also we should return an \"expected_latency_ms\" at 0/25/95 percentiles for typical prompt sizes.

anya: legal flag — for Private deployments we must add \"data_handling\": {text}, or at least a string field saying whether tool calls involve external providers. customers in finance/regulatory will need explicit wording. we shouldn't expose sensitive internal tool endpoints in the manifest.

huan: +1 to latency percentiles. implementation note: some of these values are runtime-derived (percentiles) and others are static model metadata — we should mark \"dynamic\" vs \"static\" in the manifest so clients know when to cache.

naomi: launch criteria suggestion: 1) manifest endpoint returns full shape for hosted models; 2) doc + SDK helpers; 3) basic e2e tests (tool list correctness, streaming flag, token limits); 4) perf stats available for top 3 models; 5) backward-compatible for older model ids. thoughts?

kevin: add: regression tests that simulate fallback routing (model variant not supporting tools -> automatic downgrade message). Also a test for JSON schema enforcement for structured output.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline status: manifest-api branch -> CI passed, staging deploy queued (ETA ~30m) :rocket:

naomi: ok — action items: huan/kevin to draft schema + cache semantics by EOD, sara to define recommended rate limits for discovery calls, anya to draft legal blurb for private deployments, i'll add to next roadmap sprint if we get green on staging. :eyes:
